Coast to Coast AM with George Noory

A compelling pair of potential Loch Ness Monster sightings featuring intriguing visual evidence captured on consecutive days has been added to the official 2026 tally. The more recent case reportedly occurred on August 6th as Jocelyn Boyce was visiting the popular Scottish tourist destination from her home in Barcelona. "I was at a viewpoint at Urquhart Castle overlooking Loch Ness with my family," she recalled, "when we noticed a dark, almost black, mound-like shape protruding above the surface of the water." Estimating that the anomalous object was about half a mile from where they stood, she managed to capture a brief video of the oddity (seen in this screenshot) before it vanished beneath the surface of Loch Ness seconds later.

Find out about the 2nd sighting added to the tally and more on this story at the Coast to Coast AM website.
